## Checklist

- [ ] `python scripts/check_site.py` passes (CI runs it too)
- [ ] New or changed pages are listed in `assets/js/nav.js` and follow `CONTRIBUTING.md`
- [ ] Figures have captions; facts about the Bambu X2D / AMS 2 Pro are sourced or marked "typical"
- [ ] Interactive changes tried in a browser, including a phone-width view
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `[Unreleased]` (skip for pure typos)
- [ ] Release PRs only: `VERSION`, `assets/js/nav.js` and the top `CHANGELOG.md` heading all name the new version
